recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-5237 unless FHIR-I or the relevant clinical work groups reopen standardized negation modeling outside the existing resource-specific pages.
issue_request: FHIR-5237 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core FHIR-I ballot issue for DSTU1. It objected that modifier-extension examples such as using Condition to say a patient does not have a diagnosis, no-known-allergies, and rule-out diagnoses needed positive standardized guidance rather than only advice to avoid modifier extensions. The approved resolution was narrower: change the examples of modifier extensions, with the Jira comment explaining that the Extensibility page was the general fallback and resource-specific comments belonged on the specific resources.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5237. The closest historical application is c844cc1d382c0df547670aa996e24347ac204cdf8 from 2015-03-18, which changed source/extensibility.html by removing weaker modifier-extension examples and revising the example block before Jira was commented as done. Later, FHIR-7386 directly corrected the same Condition example through fbb5823018ed5a3b9736b8a17c67c503f34a26b8 by replacing the confusing patient-does-not-have/refuted wording with family-history wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini and source/hierarchy.xml keep source/extensibility.html in current build scope. The page now uses Patient.contact do-not-contact, Condition family-history, Procedure performer-not-involved, and value-set subsumption examples, and its conformance rules require special handling for unrecognized modifier extensions. Current Condition, AllergyIntolerance, and FamilyMemberHistory pages carry resource-specific positive guidance for no-known-problems, refuted conditions, no-known-allergies, and family-history negation. Related FHIR-7386 and FHIR-18347 are already represented on the combined branch and were not duplicated.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already implements the final FHIR-5237 directive to change the general modifier-extension examples, and later source/resource-specific guidance addresses the clinical-negation concern without adding redundant or overbroad guidance to the general Extensibility page.
